scope: 71 gallery images from the five user-provided OLX ads, fetched 2026-10-30. All inspected via contact sheets; key labels additionally inspected at original size. No checkout/project/database edits.
important_limits: Carbon wording is a seller finish/variant label; photographs do not establish actual carbon-fibre construction.
Images do not confirm current available stock quantities.
Most products have one actual angle only; never synthesize unseen geometry.
Group images must not be represented as an exclusive single-color view.
No exact year, model, dimensions or technical fitment may be inferred solely from shape.
